new_standard.title: Plastics Collapsible Containers for Human Blood and Blood Components — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for sterile, non-pyrogenic plastic blood collection bag systems containing anticoagulant solution (CPD / CPD-A1).

new_standard.performance_requirements: Razor-sharp tissue dissection with zero blade detachment or chatter during surgical incision.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Cutting sharpness test on calibrated test foil per Annex B, hardness test per IS 1586, corrosion test per IS 7531.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MHD 1 Surgical Instruments Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MHD 1 Sectional Committee Specifications; CDSCO Class A Surgical Devices

new_standard.title: Anaesthetic and Respiratory Equipment — Nebulizing Systems and Components — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies safety and performance requirements for medical nebulizers (ultrasonic mesh, piezoelectric, and jet nebulizers) used for aerosolizing medications for respiratory inhalation.
new_standard.materials: Biocompatible medical polymers, piezoceramic vibrating transducer, aerosol chamber, medication cup.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Aerosol output rate (min 0.2 ml/min), Mass Median Aerodynamic Diameter MMAD (1 to 5 microns for alveolar deposition), respirable fraction (< 5 um particles min 60%), residual drug volume (max 0.5 ml), operating temperature limit, electrical safety per IEC 60601-1.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Delivers bronchodilators directly into deep lung bronchial airways; quiet ultrasonic operation.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Particle size distribution measurement by cascade impactor per Annex C, aerosol output test per Annex D.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MHD 11 / CDSCO

mapping.evidence_source: CDSCO Medical Device Rules 2017 (Class B Device); BIS MHD 11
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Compulsory registration and conformity to IS/ISO 27427 for all medical nebulizing systems in India.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory medical standard for ultrasonic and mesh medical nebulizers.

new_standard.title: Washer-Disinfectors for Medical Equipment — General Requirements and Tests
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and performance tests for ultrasonic cleaners and automated washer-disinfectors used in Central Sterile Services Departments (CSSD) for cleaning surgical instruments.
new_standard.materials: Stainless steel 316L tank, ultrasonic piezoelectric transducers (frequency 38 to 40 kHz), digital heating timer control.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Ultrasonic cavitation energy distribution, soil removal efficiency from complex surgical box joints and lumens, water temperature control (up to 60°C), drain cycle, electrical safety per IEC 61010-2-040.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Dislodges dried blood, bone, and bio-burden from surgical micro-instruments prior to autoclave sterilization.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Cavitation foil erosion test per Annex B, residual protein test per ISO 15883-1, electrical insulation test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MHD 14 CSSD Equipment Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MHD 14 Sectional Committee Specifications; NABH CSSD Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes cleaning efficacy and safety requirements for ultrasonic washer-disinfectors in hospitals.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for ultrasonic surgical instrument cleaners.

new_standard.title: Urine Collection Bags: Part 2 Requirements and Test Methods
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for sterile body-worn and bedside urine collection bags (capacity 2000 ml).
new_standard.materials: Medical-grade clear plasticized PVC sheet with non-return flutter valve, graduated volume scale, bottom drainage T-tap.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Capacity, scale graduation accuracy (+/- 10%), tensile strength of suspension eyelets and tubing (min 20 N), non-return valve leak prevention during inversion, bottom outlet valve closure integrity, sterile and non-pyrogenic.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Prevents retrograde bacterial migration into urinary tract; leak-proof bedside collection.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Inversion leakage test under 10 kPa pressure, scale volume verification, suspension eyelet pull test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MHD 12 / CDSCO Medical Device Rules

mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory medical device standard for sterile urine collection bags.
